scenes: A humid country, with a hot dry season.
The weather service marks March to May as the hot dry season. | And the national adaptation plan finds night-time lows rising faster than daytime highs.
Warnings use four heat index bands. | From forty-two degrees, it’s a danger level.
Local disaster offices plan the response, | labour guidance protects workers such as delivery riders, | and cities like Quezon City have heat action teams.
Warnings that switch on protection, from city hall to the street.
